candidateC2.mechanism: The original client derives the Classic Integrity nonce from the Google credential and mints a new token. A successful new mint is serialized as client_attestation.play_integrity_token with the legacy top-level play_integrity_token set to null. A failed new mint falls back to the original legacy flow.

candidateC2.successCriterion: Actual Claude login succeeds after the original credential-bound mint; feature activation or token length alone is not success.
